description: Flooding Susceptibility (soils) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Environment and Water. Susceptibility to flooding imposes a serious limitation on land especially where infrastructure is required. Mapping shows the proportion of land susceptible to flooding, while detailed proportion data are supplied for calculating total areas of susceptible land (spatial data statistics). Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Environment and Water. Its tags are agriculture, land use, soil, soil and land attribute data, soil attributes. It offers 6 resource(s) in geojson, html, kmz, pdf, shp. The portal shows 2020-02-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
